title: Fake Job Scam and New Contract Win in Malaysia
description: Recent news highlights a significant loss from a fake job scam in Sabah and a major contract win for NuEnergy in Johor.

sources.title: Fake Sabah subcontract job costs Kuching woman over RM145,000
Woman Loses RM145,247 Chasing Fake Sabah Subcontract Deal
NuEnergy wins RM44.5mil Johor data centre contract

sections.heading: Fake Job Scam in Sabah
paragraphs: According to the Borneo Post, a fake Sabah subcontract job cost a Kuching woman over RM145,000.
Similarly, the Sarawak Tribune reports that a woman lost RM145,247 while chasing a fake Sabah subcontract deal.

sections.heading: NuEnergy Contract Win
paragraphs: The Star reports that NuEnergy has won a RM44.5 million contract for a data centre in Johor.

sections.heading: Search Interest
paragraphs: The term 'job' is trending in Malaysia with a search volume lower bound of 100, according to the Google Trends report.

faq.q: How much money was lost in the fake job scam?
faq.a: According to the Sarawak Tribune, a woman lost RM145,247, while the Borneo Post reports the loss was over RM145,000.

faq.q: Which company won a data centre contract?
faq.a: The Star reports that NuEnergy won a RM44.5 million contract for a Johor data centre.
